basic_details.short_information: Central University of South Bihar (CUSB), Gaya, has invited applications for 25 posts in 22 roles under Advt No. CUSB/Advt./49/2026. The posts include Agricultural Extension Education (Assistant Professor), Plant Pathology (Associate Professor), Entomology (Associate Professor), Mathematics (Assistant Professor) and 18 more. The online application is open from 7 November 2026 to 7 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online Payment Gateway. Last date to pay the fee: 7 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUSB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online through CU Chayan Portal available on the University website. Fill in all required information correctly on the online portal. Upload photograph, signature, and self-attested photocopies of certificates and publications. Pay the application processing fee through the online payment gateway. Apply on or before 7 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates who applied vide earlier Advt. No. CUSB/Advt./45/2025 and CUSB/Advt./47/2026 need to apply afresh with latest OBC/EWS certificate but need not pay fee if already paid. Only online applications are accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CUSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 3 December 2026. Applications opened on 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CUSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 25 vacancies: 1 Agricultural Extension Education (Assistant Professor), 1 Plant Pathology (Associate Professor), 1 Entomology (Associate Professor), 1 Mathematics (Assistant Professor), 2 Statistics (Professor/Associate Professor), 1 Bioinformatics (Associate Professor) and 16 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CUSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR, OBC & EWS: Rs. 2,000. SC, ST, PwBD and Female: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 10 for Agricultural Extension Education (Assistant Professor), Level 13A for Plant Pathology (Associate Professor), Level 13A for Entomology (Associate Professor), Level 10 for Mathematics (Assistant Professor), Level 13A / Level 14 for Statistics (Professor/Associate Professor).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in concerned/allied/relevant discipline with Ph.D. and/or NET/SLET/SET as per UGC Regulations, 2018. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates applying for reserved posts must enclose category certificates issued by competent authority. In-service applicants must upload NOC from their employer with a clear specification that no vigilance case is pending. Separate applications and fees must be submitted for each post if applying for more than one.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with incomplete applications or without required certificates. Applicants without requisite qualifications and experience as on closing date.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Academic score based shortlisting for interview. Interview performance. Seminar / colloquium / Lecture / written test as supplementary methods if required. Shortlisting based on academic score as specified in Appendix II (Table 3A) of UGC Regulations 2018.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Regular basis.
